App Icon Resizer

Generate every common app icon size from one image — 16, 32, 48, 180, 192 and 512 px — with instant preview and one-click PNG downloads.

Tip: a 1024×1024 master gives the sharpest small icons.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your master icon artwork (square works best).
  2. Preview all six standard sizes instantly.
  3. Download each size individually, or all sizes at once.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which icon sizes are generated?

16×16 and 32×32 favicons, 48×48, 180×180 (Apple touch icon), 192×192 and 512×512 (PWA / Android).

Should my source image have rounded corners?

Use the rounded-corner option if you want, but Apple and Android round icons automatically — square master artwork is the safest starting point.

Are the icons exported as PNG?

Icons are exported as PNG with crisp resampling. Large transparent areas stay transparent.

Is my image uploaded?

No — everything runs locally in your browser.
